extracted.name: Persian Cucumber Yogurt (Maast-o Khiar)
extracted.description: This cool and healthy dip can be served along side rice and meat, or simply with bread. No Persian meal is complete without Maast-o khiar! This dish is best if refrigerated for a few hours, but if you are strapped for time feel free to serve after mixing.
ingredient_lines: 3 Persian cucumbers - peeled, trimmed, and cut into 1/4-inch cubes
instruction_lines: Stir yogurt, cucumbers, garlic, and shallot together in a medium bowl; season with dill, salt, and pepper. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to blend flavors.
